data.body: Repair evidence before Gerrit: baseline module 35.93s; final serial 12.25s (23.68s / 65.9% faster) and xdist -n2 12.27s. Held-out oracle /tmp/rebar_build_count_oracle.py was RED before repair (3 successful REBAR_BUILD_COMMIT=abc1234 prerequisite builds per worker/session), GREEN after repair (exactly 1; 7 passed), and RED again under a defect-seeded duplicate build (count 2). Corrupting the shared wheel's COMMIT returned the provenance assertion to RED (None != abc1234), then restoration returned GREEN. The fixture is session-scoped per worker, returns only immutable artifact paths, and consumers preserve distinct coverage: install-from-sdist still extracts locally and performs its env-unset rebuild; empty-env still performs a real failing build. No test, assertion, platform, Python version, coverage, or runner was removed; no new dependency. Lint/typecheck pass. Commit 8bdad57be7 carries the canonical ticket trailer. This matches Setuptools/PyPA's OSS practice of reusing immutable built artifacts within a test job.
